title: Pairwise coordinate correspondence
statement: For each nonnegative integer $n$, pairs of sign vectors of length $n$ are in bijection with functions assigning a pair of signs to each of the $n$ coordinates. The correspondence pairs the two signs at each coordinate, and its inverse recovers the two sign vectors from those coordinatewise pairs.
